affected_predicate.description: All #OpenTalk lectures in the actual current month are represented as calendar events with the specified time, location, topic, and reminder offset.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, the agent independently began treating the singular current month as the multi-month range “Oct–Dec 2025,” despite the task requesting lectures for the current month.

chains.rationale: At target step 19, the reused reasoning explicitly repeats both the incorrect “Oct–Dec 2025” scope and the same feed-scroll action. From that target through the last observable step, every action remains a downward feed scroll, including many static transitions; no action corrects the month scope, opens Calendar, creates an event, or configures a reminder. The repeated scanning mechanism therefore remains unbroken and visibly leaves the affected calendar-event predicate unsatisfied in the supplied trace.

summary: The sole strict-MHR reuse target visibly continues an incorrect multi-month interpretation and initiates an uninterrupted sequence of feed scrolling through the terminal trace. No observable correction or calendar-event work occurs.
